시편-146-1.title: 시편 146장 1절 역사문법적 주해
시편-146-1.exegesis: PSALM 146 Psa 146:1-10 . An exhortation to praise God, who, by the gracious and faithful exercise of His power in goodness to the needy, is alone worthy of implicit trust.
시편-146-1.theologicalNote: PSALM 146 Psa 146:1-10 . An exhortation to praise God, who, by the gracious and faithful exercise of His power in goodness to the needy, is alone worthy of implicit trust.
